title: Landscape Horticulture Technician
author: Dayone Koo
_comment: Dialectical surface for the Foothill Landscape Horticulture Technician report. Edit this file; the /report/saved/ endpoint re-renders on refresh. Fields mirror ReportSpec overrides (lede, *_note, live_postings). Feeder: TOP 010900 Horticulture, Foothill 14 awards 2024-25; Merritt College leads the region (010910, 48). EDITORIAL DECISIONS ON RECORD: (a) 37-1012 carries entry-tier postings (BrightView 'Landscaper I', Six Flags 'Landscaper') rather than supervisor-titled ones — no employer in the region posts a supervisor title, and the entry tier is the pathway a Horticulture completer actually enters, with 37-1012 the promotion destination above it. (b) 37-3012 returned ZERO CareerOneStop listings — a genuine NONE verdict, carried in demand_note rather than hidden. (c) 37-3011 Landscaping & Groundskeeping Workers (Bay: 4,880 openings, the family's largest) is deliberately OUT of the ontology: COE lists it 'No formal educational credential', below the middle-skill gate the occupation universe is grounded on — admitting it would also admit Janitors/Maids/Grounds-Maintenance-All-Other. (d) 37-3013 Tree Trimmers ($69,260, middle-skill) was considered and rejected: TOP 010900/010910 do not crosswalk to it and it is in no sector.
demand_note: The U.S. Department of Labor's [O*NET system](https://www.onetonline.org/find/quick?s=Landscape+Horticulture) maps this role to two standard occupational classifications supported by Foothill's Horticulture program. [According to the Centers of Excellence](https://datastudio.google.com/u/0/reporting/5060057c-b9ba-4081-9ed7-83356eaa7061), together they represent roughly 580 openings a year in the Bay Area labor market — the supervisory tier (37-1012) accounting for 500 of them at a $63,150 median. A search of [CareerOneStop](https://www.careeronestop.org/Toolkit/Jobs/find-jobs.aspx) returned no current Bay Area postings under the Pesticide Handlers classification (37-3012), whose 80 openings a year make it the smaller and more specialized of the two; the live postings below therefore evidence the landscaping tier that Horticulture completers enter directly.

37-3012.description: Mixes and applies pesticides, herbicides, and fungicides to trees, shrubs, lawns, and crops — work that requires specific training and state certification.

37-1012.description: Directs and coordinates landscaping and groundskeeping crews — reviewing contracts to determine service, machine, and workforce requirements.
